name: Neural Radiative Transfer Equation Solver
aliases: Neural network-based real-time volume rendering method
RPNN variant with hierarchical transmittance and sampling templates
definition: A real-time volume rendering method that uses a neural network to simulate the iterative integration process of solving the Radiative Transfer Equation (RTE), replacing traditional path tracing to achieve real-time performance for high albedo anisotropic materials with multiple scattering.
